enchanting_overhauled.config.enchantment: Whether all scalable enchantments should adhere to the global Max Enchantment Level.
The global max level of scalable enchantments.
The maximum amount of enchantments an item can hold.
The amount of enchantments randomly generated Enchanted Tomes have. Bound by Max Amount of Enchantments.

The global maximum xp requirement cost of enchantments.
Master toggle for the Enchanting Overhauled custom tooltip formatter.
The execution priority of this formatter in Enchantment Core (higher priority executes earlier).

Determines which enchantment sources display text in the Standard Galactic Alphabet (SGA).

NONE: Never obfuscate.
FLEETING: Obfuscate fleeting sources only.
UNTAGGED: Obfuscate fleeting and untagged sources.
FULL: Obfuscate all stored enchantment sources.

Determines the component type to hide curses on.

NONE: Curses are always shown.
APPLIED: Curses are hidden on enchanted items.
SOURCE: Curses are hidden on enchantment sources.
ALL: Curses are always hidden.
enchanting_overhauled.config.client.ench: Whether the enchanting table buttons should be plain or have hidden messages.

Determines where custom coloring and formatting rules are applied in the Enchanting Altar.

NONE: Vanilla formatting everywhere.
WIDGET: Applies to the enchantment list buttons.
TOOLTIP: Applies to the hovering tooltips.
ALL: Applies to both buttons and tooltips.

Controls how enchantment names are colored by their assigned theme.

NONE: Vanilla formatting.
NORMAL: Apply theme colors, but keep curses red.
FULL: Apply theme colors to all enchantments, including curses.

Controls how enchantment level numerals are colored.

NONE: Vanilla numeral coloring.
NORMAL: Apply theme colors, but keep curses red.
FULL: Apply theme colors to all numerals, including curses.
Whether scaling enchantments should be suffixed by their level numeral at first level.
enchanting_overhauled.config.client.scri: The ARGB color value for the borders of unrevealed cells on the Scribe grid.
The ARGB color value for the borders of revealed cells on the Scribe grid.

Determines where custom coloring and formatting rules are applied in the Scribe Menu.

NONE: Vanilla formatting everywhere.
WIDGET: Applies to the text in the enchantment lists.
TOOLTIP: Applies to the hovering tooltips.
ALL: Applies to both lists and tooltips.

Controls how enchantment names are colored by their assigned theme.

NONE: Vanilla formatting.
NORMAL: Apply theme colors, but keep curses red.
FULL: Apply theme colors to all enchantments, including curses.

Controls how enchantment level numerals are colored.

NONE: Vanilla numeral coloring.
NORMAL: Apply theme colors, but keep curses red.
FULL: Apply theme colors to all numerals, including curses.

Controls which headers appear above enchantment listings on item tooltips.

NONE: Never display headers.
APPLIED: Show only for applied enchantments.
STORED: Show only for stored enchantments.
ALL: Show for both applied and stored enchantments.

NORMAL: Apply theme colors, but keep curses red.

enchanting_overhauled.config.global.ench: Whether or not trying to activate the Enchanting Altar with a Book, Book and Quill, Written Book, or Enchanted Book causes a violent explosion.
Whether activating the Enchanting Altar should summon a Lightning Strike, Particle and Sound Effects.
Whether the activated Enchanting Altar can be mined or instead drops its tome.
The navigation step size for the Enchanting Altar menu. Only applicable if 'Max Amount of Enchantments' is greater than 3.

Defines the level requirement of the source item when upgrading enchantments at the Enchanting Altar.

NONE: upgrades require no existing enchantment level on the source item.
EQUAL: the source item must possess an enchantment level equal to or greater than the current level.
GREATER: the source item must possess an enchantment level greater than the current level.

Defines the resolution behavior when a source item possesses a higher enchantment level than the target item.

TRANSFER: the UI offers to overwrite the target's enchantment with the exact level from the source.
UPGRADE: the UI utilizes the source as a catalyst to unlock the standard randomized upgrade roll.
The maximum enchanting power the Enchanting Altar can utilize for slot generation and XP level requirement discounts.
Defines how available enchanting power is halved across multiple enchantment slots.
enchanting_overhauled.config.global.lect: Whether losing a game of Scribe causes a violent explosion.

Controls when enchantment sources are processed during the Scribe minigame.

NONE: All non-persistent sources are processed immediately on game start.
UNTAGGED: Only fleeting sources are processed immediately. Untagged sources wait until win/loss.
FULL: No sources are processed immediately. All non-persistent sources wait until win/loss.
Whether the Lapis Lazuli is refunded if the player aborts the Scribe minigame (i.e. processed at the end).
The multiplier for the lapis cost based on the number of mines. If 0, the cost is a constant 1.
The amount of XP points awarded per contradiction upon successfully scribing an enchantment.
The multiplier for how many contradiction are added per enchantment level on the target book.
How many seconds the failed grid is displayed before resetting (if Arcane Retribution is disabled).
The RGB color value of the progress bar shown during a failed scribe display.

Which variant of the Scribe minigame to play.

CLASSIC: Standard minesweeper generation.
SUPERPOSITION: Dynamic quantum solver preventing unavoidable 50/50 guesses.

Determines at which enchantment level an Enchanted Book is converted into an Enchanted Tome when successfully upgrading an applied enchantment.

NONE: Always converts.
CUSTOM: Converts when reaching custom level.
MAXED: Converts when reaching max level.
OVERLEVELED: Converts when exceeding max level.
DISABLED: Never converts on upgrade.

Sets the enchantment level at which an Enchanted Book is converted into an Enchanted Tome when successfully upgrading an applied enchantment. Only active if "tome_conversion_upgrade_condition" is set to CUSTOM.

Determines at which enchantment count an Enchanted Book is converted into an Enchanted Tome when successfully appending a new enchantment.

CAP: Converts when reaching max enchantment capacity.
CUSTOM: Converts when reaching custom count.
DISABLED: Never converts on append.

Sets the amount of enchantments at which an Enchanted Book is converted into an Enchanted Tome when successfully appending a new enchantment. Only active if "tome_conversion_append_condition" is set to CUSTOM.
